issue.title: Mac Refs documentation exceeds the mounted reference word budget after Highlights-save docs
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.land. bob-mac-capture 72cd721e591a02cd686af3951fcbbdb41d22f6ae adds Highlights-save behavior to docs/refs.md. On bob-cli be181978 with plugin 3a7368a and Mac 72cd721 mounted explicitly, npm run docs:check (BOB_CLI_DIR set to the active bob-cli checkout; BOB_DOCS_BOB_MAC_CAPTURE_DIR set to the opened Mac repo) fails: docs/reference/mac-capture/refs.md:1: budget: over budget at 6027 words (cap 6000 for reference/). Repeated with the workspace sources after the default plugin docs command produced the same result. The docs diff since green Mac SHA 9759771 adds the save-scan section; no current-epic documentation source change caused it. Condense the source-of-truth Mac docs/refs.md below its mounted budget while retaining the save-scan behavior, permissions, defaults, and keyboard contracts; do not raise the global cap. Verify through the shared docs gate with explicit local mounts. All-status searches and last-week CI/all-type task sweep found no duplicate; none of the active epic scopes owns this standalone save-scan change. Distinct from bob-cli-bg, which owns the same commit’s Swift initializer compile failure.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both docs-check runs fail at 6027 words versus a fixed 6000-word reference cap; the mounted source file deterministically exceeds the lint budget.

issue.creation_reason: Found during integrated docs validation for bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6 landing. A later Mac save-scan documentation change makes the shared docs gate fail, independently of this epic.

payload.description: Both originate in Mac Highlights-save commit 72cd721; distinct docs-budget and XCTest compile failures

payload.entry: Supplementary evidence from bob-cli-bd.land (bob-cli-bd.7 note #1 proposed the same overage): after bob-mac-capture c5d560c ('trim refs docs under word cap'), just docs-check on bob-cli master 2eb98129 passes with the current Mac mount (docs/reference/mac-capture/refs.md now 5919 words by wc -w). This task may be ready to close once its owner confirms through the shared docs gate.
